description: This file implements a parser for HCI H4 protocol packets used in Bluetooth communication. It handles different packet types such as command, ACL, SCO, event, and ISO, and manages the parsing state machine, including recovery mode. The class H4Parser provides methods to reset the parser, process incoming bytes, and invoke callbacks when complete packets are assembled.

classes.name: H4Parser
classes.description: A parser class for Bluetooth HCI H4 protocol packets, managing state and callbacks for different packet types.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the parser state to initial conditions.

methods.name: HciGetPacketLengthForType
methods.description: Calculates the length of the packet payload based on the packet type and preamble.

methods.name: OnPacketReady
methods.description: Invokes the appropriate callback when a complete packet has been parsed.

methods.name: BytesRequested
methods.description: Returns the number of bytes needed to continue parsing the current packet.

methods.name: Consume
methods.description: Processes incoming bytes, updates parser state, and handles recovery if necessary.
